text: I'm sure you've seen this already, but if not: [VIDEO] A 3:1 scale replica of the Curta, 3D printed.
Maybe have a look at the Curta for inspiration of a mechanical calculator. There's a 3D printable version of it. [VIDEO] [LINK]

story: ReCurta: Our goal is to build the first Curta calculator since 1972
text: Marcus Wu designed, 3D-printed, and assembled a 3x scale working Curta calculator. He shared his models and progress on Thingverse at [LINK] His YouTube channel includes many videos of the development, assembly, and operation of his calculator. Watch a short demonstration at [LINK] Adam Savage commissioned Marcus to build a copy. Adam unboxes his 3D-printed Curta on YouTube at [VIDEO]
